description: Sauron launches his war on Gondor as Frodo and Sam approach Mordor, Aragorn accepts the burden of his ancestry and Rohan rides to Minas Tirith. The war and the Ring quest converge at Mount Doom.

s03e01.description: The Ring's corrupting power is revealed through Sméagol's murder of Déagol, while the victors of Helm's Deep confront Saruman at Isengard. Pippin's encounter with the palantír reveals Sauron's plan to strike Gondor, sending Gandalf racing to Minas Tirith as Aragorn's destiny and Arwen's choice force Elrond to act.

s03e02.description: Frodo, Sam and Gollum reach Minas Morgul and begin the climb toward Cirith Ungol as Sauron's army marches on Gondor. Osgiliath falls, Pippin lights the beacon to summon Rohan, Théoden answers Gondor's call, and Denethor sends Faramir into a near-suicidal counterattack while Gollum works to turn Frodo against Sam.

s03e03.description: At Dunharrow, Elrond brings Aragorn Andúril and warns that only the Army of the Dead can give Gondor a chance. Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli enter the haunted mountain to demand the oathbreakers' allegiance, while Frodo is led toward Shelob's lair and Minas Tirith comes under full siege.

s03e04.description: Minas Tirith's defenses collapse just as Rohan arrives and charges Sauron's army. Éowyn and Merry destroy the Witch-king, Aragorn returns with the Army of the Dead and the Pelennor Fields are won at terrible cost; meanwhile Sam rescues Frodo, and the surviving leaders decide to draw Sauron's forces away from Mount Doom by marching on the Black Gate.

s03e05.description: Frodo and Sam cross Mordor toward Mount Doom as exhaustion and the Ring push Frodo toward collapse. Aragorn confronts Sauron's forces at the Black Gate to buy them time; at the Crack of Doom, Gollum's final struggle with Frodo destroys the Ring and Sauron, after which the survivors reunite, Aragorn is crowned and Frodo eventually departs Middle-earth from the Grey Havens.
